title: FiLoRA: Focus-and-Ignore LoRA for Controllable Feature Reliance

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the model's internal reliance on superficial, non-semantic dataset artifacts (such as visual appearance, background, and low-level acoustic cues) versus core semantic features using metrics like Gate Modulation Range (GMR), Reliance Sensitivity (RS), and decision stability after spurious feature removal.

Categorizing demographic traits (e.g., age, gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic status) and identity attributes (e.g., skin tone, language) as spurious feature groups within datasets like CREMA-D and RAVDESS, and evaluating the model's prediction sensitivity (RS) to these specific features when perturbed via instruction-conditioned gating.
